project_info.theme: Beauty campaign portrait for YSL Lovestore
project_info.color_palette: Soft taupe, black denim, nude peach lips, chrome silver, light blush pink

main_subject.detail: A centered beauty portrait of a dark-haired female model in a black denim jacket holding multiple silver YSL Loveshine and Make Me Blush products near her face with glossy black nails. Bottom text reads 'YSL LOVESTORE', 'YSL LOVESHINE & MAKE ME BLUSH', and 'YvesSaintLaurent'.
main_subject.style: Luxury beauty endorsement portrait, polished campaign photography, intimate makeup-focus close-up

composition_elements.text: YSL LOVESTORE, YSL LOVESHINE & MAKE ME BLUSH, YvesSaintLaurent
items: Top Left: Soft neutral studio background with the model's dark hair framing the face
Top Right: Calm direct gaze with subtle earrings and polished makeup
Bottom Left: Hands with glossy black manicure holding multiple silver YSL products near the cheek
Bottom Right: White stacked campaign typography ending with the YvesSaintLaurent wordmark
Center/Background: Tight portrait of the model in a black denim jacket, lit cleanly against a muted taupe backdrop

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Smooth skin glow, reflective chrome product highlights, controlled catchlights in the eyes, premium campaign softness

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality vertical luxury beauty campaign poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a photoreal portrait of a dark-haired female model in a black denim jacket holding several silver YSL beauty products near her face with glossy black nails. Include the exact text 'YSL LOVESTORE', 'YSL LOVESHINE & MAKE ME BLUSH', and 'YvesSaintLaurent' stacked in white near the lower half. Background is a soft neutral taupe studio field. Technical style: photoreal beauty campaign photography, soft beauty portrait lighting, smooth skin glow and reflective chrome highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Female campaign model portrait reference
assets.usage: Preserve facial features, eye contact, hair styling, jacket collar, and hand pose

assets.name: YSL Loveshine and Make Me Blush products

assets.name: Portrait campaign typography layout

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If recreating with a real campaign face, attach the exact face reference rather than free-generating another model. Keep the image vertically cropped and intimate, with the products functioning as part of the portrait pose.
